1.title: Company profile website Alkaf Store
desc: This project focuses on creating a responsive and fast company profile website to enhance the brand image of Alkaf Store in the digital market.
I was fully responsible for converting Figma designs into functional React code, optimizing page performance (Core Web Vitals), and implementing direct contact features.
The result is a 40% increase in user engagement on the homepage and a 15% decrease in bounce rate.

5.title: Company Profile Honey
desc: As a Fullstack Developer for this project, my main responsibility was to develop and maintain a modern and user-friendly company profile website platform using Laravel 12 and Tailwind CSS. In this role, I took full responsibility for the product development cycle, from system architecture planning and responsive UI/UX design implementation, to MySQL database integration for content management, deployment, and application performance monitoring. One of my key achievements was successfully designing an admin dashboard using Filament, allowing the internal team to efficiently manage content, photo galleries, and portfolio data without requiring technical programming knowledge. Additionally, I was responsible for optimizing the website's loading speed, ensuring a seamless user experience, and collaborating with the design team to maintain a consistent and professional brand image across the digital platform.

6.title: Web Monitoring CCTV
desc: As a Frontend Developer at PT. Inovasi Tjaraka Buana from April 2026 to August 2026, my main responsibility was to develop a responsive web dashboard for real-time CCTV monitoring using React.js and Tailwind CSS. In this role, I integrated Dahua REST APIs to manage live stream data, playback, and device status, while ensuring optimal interface load times. To improve efficiency, I also leveraged AI tools to accelerate the creation of visual components, logic implementation, and troubleshooting of technical issues. Aside from technical aspects, I actively collaborated with the DevOps team and field technicians to ensure smooth synchronization of API data with hardware components.

7.title: Web REKBER
desc: Rekber (Joint Account) is an e-commerce platform designed to facilitate online transactions with a higher level of security. It acts as a trusted intermediary between buyers and sellers, ensuring that transaction funds are securely held until the purchased goods or services have been received and approved by the buyer. Key features of Rekber include user identity verification, an escrow system for holding funds, and a transparent dispute resolution mechanism. By adopting blockchain technology for transparency and data security, Rekber offers an efficient solution for digital economy participants seeking peace of mind and certainty in every online transaction.

8.title: HPP Application
desc: The HPP Application is a platform designed to help small and medium enterprises (SMEs) calculate the Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for their products. This application provides features such as input for raw material costs, labor costs, overhead costs, and automatic COGS calculation.
